data.title: 忍冬 · 雨停之前
data.description: 雨落在拱廊外，她没有急着走。咖啡已经喝到一半，忍冬看着街对面逐渐积起的水，决定再坐一会儿。
data.action: 坐在露天桌边等待雨停
data.camera: 中景，雨幕和桌上咖啡同框
data.promptProse: Sitting at a cozy outdoor cafe table under a wide vaulted stone arcade while a torrential Mediterranean rainstorm washes the street, Vulpisfoglia sips an espresso with composed relaxation. Cascading rainwater gushes from stone gargoyle spouts into glistening cobblestone gutters, while warm cafe lamps illuminate her sharp, handsome features against the gray storm.
